submitted.body: **Owner decisions recorded 26 November 2026.** Settings default to System theme, Glass surface, Comfortable density, motion on and Target cursor. Motion stays on when Windows requests reduced motion unless the member chooses Off or Follow system. WI-044 is added to Sprint-3 between WI-034 and WI-035 for the motion token table and timings. Only Sev-1 blocks the release; a failed PI acceptance criterion counts as Sev-1. Edge owns the Scrum lifecycle and may resequence or move proposed work with a recorded reason. Session tokens stay in memory; account keys, invitation tokens and tokens stay out of the repository, notes, logs and screenshots. QA uses disposable stores via FOUNDATIONOS_DATA and a client data-directory override. Evidence lives under `versions/0.2 FoundationOS/qa/`; contributor artifacts under `agents/{role}/{WI-ID}/`.
